explanation: Replace each rate by −log10(rate), then run Bellman–Ford from currency zero. A further relaxation after the initial passes reveals a reachable negative cycle, which corresponds to a profitable product of rates. Every currency is reachable in the exchange-rate matrix.
timeComplexity: O(n^3) time for an n-by-n matrix.
spaceComplexity: O(n^2) space for the copied/transformed matrix, plus O(n) distances.
